visible_condition: box is clean and intact with no visible damage
hidden_risks: whether the actual console and controllers are inside the box
functional condition and working state of the console
presence of all original cables and accessories
response.best_proof: A photo showing the open box with the console and accessories inside
seller_claims_unsupported: Fully boxed (contents inside cannot be verified from external box photos alone)
response.failure_mode: Assuming the console inside is present, tested, and fully functional based solely on pictures of the outer box.
